procedure: Come onto your hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back, forming an inverted V-shape.
Press firmly through your palms and straighten your legs without locking your knees.
Hold the posture for 5 to 10 deep breaths.
Start on your hands and knees in a tabletop position.
Inhale, arch your back, and lift your head and tailbone towards the ceiling (Cow).
Exhale, round your spine, and tuck your chin to your chest (Cat).
Repeat this flow for 5-10 breaths.
benefits: Relieves tension in the back and neck

procedure: Kneel on the floor with your big toes touching and knees spread apart.
Sit back on your heels and exhale as you lay your torso down between your thighs.
Extend your arms forward or rest them by your sides.
Hold for 1-3 minutes.
benefits: Gently stretches hips, thighs, and ankles
Calms the brain and helps relieve stress and fatigue

procedure: Lie face down with your legs extended and tops of your feet on the floor.
Place your hands under your shoulders and hug your elbows to your body.
Inhale and lift your chest off the floor, keeping your lower ribs on the mat.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then exhale and release.
benefits: Stretches chest and lungs, shoulders, and abdomen

procedure: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Keep your arms alongside your body with palms facing down.
Inhale, press into your feet, and lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Hold for 30-60 seconds, then exhale and roll your spine slowly down to the floor.
benefits: Stretches the chest, neck, and spine
Calms the brain and helps alleviate stress
Stimulates abdominal organs, lungs, and thyroid
